## Evidence

- [ ] Every new entry has at least one source URL, preferably from the authority itself
- [ ] `derived` entries have `verified:` lines naming the register and the date
- [ ] `avoid` entries have a `reason`
- [ ] Values list the validators they must pass under `checks` (new validator added to `tools/checks.py` if needed)
- [ ] `python tools/validate.py` reports 0 errors
